مصطلح الشذوذ الصرفي في بابي النسب والجمع عند لطف الله بن محمد الغياث الظفيري (ت 1035هـ) في شرحه لشافية ابن الحاجب (ت 646هـ)

Authors

  • باسم محمد عيادة

DOI:

https://doi.org/10.54721/jrashc.23.3.1797

Abstract

      Some linguistic and morphological phenomena appeared in the language of the verses and the Wise Remembrance, adding strength and distinction to this language among all the languages of the world. Several phenomena emerged, such as the phenomenon of morphological irregularity, to add a distinctive splendor to its phonetic, morphological, syntactic, and semantic levels, with all that this phenomenon - irregularity - included of several levels and various morphological categories, which were changed from the original category, noting that this departure from the original category is not a reprehensible departure to the extent that it is neglected or not relied upon, but rather it was characterized by reliance on it and its preservation without being measured against it
